summary: IDF completed destruction of Hezbollah's strategic tunnel network at Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, establishing a security zone after two decades of Iranian-backed construction. Israeli forces eliminated a Hamas Nukhba terrorist in Khan Yunis involved in the October 7 killing of Nahal Brigade Commander Col. Yonatan Steinberg. Over 100 U.S. military advisers are now operating in Saudi Arabia supporting the campaign against Iran-backed Houthis, who recently seized Zuqar Island in the Red Sea.
key_points: IDF destroyed Hezbollah's underground infrastructure at Ali Taher Ridge, including kilometers of tunnels with Iranian-made missiles and UAVs, completing the security zone in southern Lebanon. (Source: @inon_yttach/10018, @N12chat/226135)

IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba terrorist Ismail Ibrahim Darwish Qandil in Khan Yunis, who participated in the October 7 killing of Col. Yonatan Steinberg and recently planned attacks against Israeli forces. (Source: @New_security8200/203751)
Israeli security assessments discussed potential Iranian offensive action, prompting heightened alert and readiness throughout the holiday period. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7013)

IAEA Director Grossi reported satellite-observed construction activity at Iran's "Pickaxe Mountain" site near the main enrichment complex, though inspectors cannot access the deep tunnels. (Source: @VahidOnline/78321)

Over 100 U.S. military advisers are deployed in Saudi Arabia under a new joint forces command providing intelligence and targeting support against Iran-backed Houthis, without direct strike participation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7021)
Houthis seized Zuqar Island in the southern Red Sea between Hodeidah and Mocha following rocket attacks and a ground assault via boats. (Source: @asafroz/53306)

IDF Northern Brigade Commander stated Hamas turned Beit Hanoun into a terror town with extensive underground tunnels, now destroyed, and identified Ridge 70 as the primary defense line for northern communities. (Source: @almogboker78/18161)
Duvdevan unit arrested terrorist Ismail Anqawi in Beitunia after a week-long manhunt; he planned an imminent shooting attack. (Source: @New_security8200/203753)

sections.executive_summary: IDF completed destruction of Hezbollah's strategic tunnel network at Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, establishing a security zone after two decades of Iranian-backed construction. Israeli forces eliminated a Hamas Nukhba terrorist in Khan Yunis involved in the October 7 killing of Nahal Brigade Commander Col. Yonatan Steinberg. Over 100 U.S. military advisers are now operating in Saudi Arabia supporting the campaign against Iran-backed Houthis, who recently seized Zuqar Island in the Red Sea.

points: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi confirmed satellite imagery shows construction activity at the "Pickaxe Mountain" (Kuh-e Kolang Gazla) site south of Iran's main enrichment complex, though inspectors have not accessed the deep tunnels; Iran previously announced plans to move equipment underground for protection against strikes. (Source: @VahidOnline/78321)

The United States imposed new sanctions on Iran through the Treasury Department, continuing hostile measures; simultaneously, Russia and China opposed UN snapback sanctions, with Russia's ambassador stating Moscow would not allow sanctions reimposition under any circumstances. (Source: @SharghDaily/182987, @Faytuks_Network/7024)

Israeli security assessments explicitly discussed the possibility of an Iranian offensive action, leading authorities to maintain heightened alert and readiness throughout the upcoming holiday period. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7013)

CNN reported the U.S. is developing a more penetrating weapon capable of destroying targets in hard rock like the Pickaxe Mountain facility, following U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iranian nuclear sites earlier in 2025. (Source: @VahidOnline/78321)

IDF completed destruction of Hezbollah's strategic tunnel network at Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, a facility built over two decades with Iranian funding and planning, intended as a base for conquering the Galilee and overlooking Metula and Kiryat Shmona. (Source: @inon_yttach/10018)

IDF forces eliminated Hamas Nukhba terrorist Ismail Ibrahim Darwish Qandil in Khan Yunis, who infiltrated Israel on October 7 and participated in killing Nahal Brigade Commander Col. Yonatan Steinberg; the terrorist recently promoted attacks against IDF forces and violated the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203751)

IDF Northern Brigade Commander Col. Omri Mesiach stated Hamas transformed Beit Hanoun into a terror town with the most extensive underground tunnels he has seen, now destroyed, and identified Ridge 70 as the most significant territory for defending northern communities and enabling offensive operations. (Source: @almogboker78/18161)

Duvdevan unit, guided by Shin Bet, arrested terrorist Ismail Anqawi in the Beitunia area after a week-long manhunt; he planned an imminent shooting attack and was apprehended before execution. (Source: @New_security8200/203753)

IDF Spokesperson at Ali Taher Ridge acknowledged heavy prices paid in battles to capture and clear the ridge, with fallen fighters, but declared the mission complete and vowed to continue defending northern communities and removing threats. (Source: @idf_telegram/25111)

IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba terrorist Ismail Ibrahim Darwish Qandil in Khan Yunis, southern Gaza, who took part in the October 7 killing of Col. Yonatan Steinberg and recently worked to rebuild Hamas capabilities while systematically violating the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203751)

IDF Northern Brigade Commander reported that Hamas had turned Beit Hanoun into a terror town with highly extensive underground tunnels, all of which have now been destroyed by Israeli forces. (Source: @almogboker78/18161)

Duvdevan unit arrested terrorist Ismail Anqawi in Beitunia, West Bank, who planned an imminent shooting attack; the arrest followed a week-long manhunt directed by Shin Bet. (Source: @New_security8200/203753)

IDF forces under Southern Command remain deployed in Gaza per the agreement and continue acting to remove immediate threats, including targeting terrorists who violate the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203751)

IDF demolished Hezbollah's major tunnel system beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, completing the security zone; the infrastructure included kilometers of tunnels containing Iranian-made missiles and UAVs, built over two decades with Iranian funding. (Source: @inon_yttach/10018, @N12chat/226135, @manniefabian/59140)

Hezbollah failed to defend the Ali Taher Ridge infrastructure despite declaring it would do so at any cost, abandoning its fighters who were either eliminated or fled; IDF Spokesperson stated Hezbollah "failed and even abandoned its people to die inside." (Source: @idf_telegram/25111, @almogboker78/18169)

Lebanese sources reported martyrdom of Hassan Ibrahim Muzi at Ali Taher, with his body remaining at the site; another report mentioned martyr Mustafa Jabir in the tunnels. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390680, @rasedal3ado138e/390674)

Kfar Reman municipality urged residents to avoid gatherings, stay indoors, not approach town outskirts, and keep windows partially open due to security situation and potential Israeli strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/42120)
An explosion targeting Israeli forces was reported in Srobbin towards Yater in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390690)
